features.title: Explore features
features.intro: Search what Gostman can do, try a feature in place and read how it works.
features.searchPlaceholder: Search features, for example snapshot, mock or git
features.desktopOnlyBody: The browser cannot reach local files, ports or system settings, so this is only in the desktop app.
features.commandDescription: Search every feature, try it and read how it works
features.commandKeywords: features index capabilities discover what can gostman do help
features.whatsNewNothing: There is nothing new to list for this version.
features.whatsNewCommandDescription: Features added in the latest version
features.exploreHint_one: Search the {{count}} feature in Gostman, try it with a sample and read how it works.
features.exploreHint_other: Search the {{count}} features in Gostman, try them with a sample and read how they work.
features.toolsMenuHint: Everything Gostman can do with your requests, by job

rest.title: REST and HTTP requests
rest.blurb: Send any method with params, headers, a body and auth, and read the status, timing and size.
rest.synonyms: http api get post put delete patch rest request

graphql.title: GraphQL
graphql.blurb: Write queries with a schema browser, a query builder and variables. Subscriptions run over WebSocket.
graphql.synonyms: graphql query mutation schema introspection subscription apollo

grpc.title: gRPC
grpc.blurb: Load services through reflection or .proto files and call unary and streaming methods.
grpc.synonyms: grpc protobuf proto reflection stream bloomrpc grpcurl

websocket.title: WebSocket, Socket.IO and MQTT
websocket.blurb: Connect, send saved messages and read a message log over WebSocket, Socket.IO or MQTT.
websocket.synonyms: websocket socket.io socketio mqtt realtime ws sse events

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.blurb: Call the tools, resources and prompts of an MCP server and check what it returns.
mcp.synonyms: mcp model context protocol tools agent server inspector

curl.title: Paste a curl command
curl.blurb: Paste a curl command into the address bar and the request fills in.
curl.synonyms: curl paste command line import clipboard

codegen.title: Code snippets
codegen.blurb: Copy the request that is sent as cURL, Python, Go, JavaScript, Java, C# and more, including axios, httpx, OkHttp, RestSharp, Guzzle, HTTPie and wget.
codegen.synonyms: code snippet generate curl python javascript fetch go java

responseViewer.title: Response viewer
responseViewer.blurb: Read JSON as a tree, preview HTML, images and PDF, filter with JSONPath and search the body.
responseViewer.synonyms: response body json preview filter search jsonpath timeline console visualize

examples.title: Saved examples
examples.blurb: Keep responses as named examples that document a request and feed the mock server.

oauth.title: Auth and OAuth 2
oauth.blurb: Basic, bearer, API key, OAuth 1 and 2, Digest, AWS SigV4, NTLM, JWT and more, with token renewal.
oauth.synonyms: auth authentication oauth oauth2 bearer token basic digest sigv4 ntlm hawk apikey

cookies.title: Cookie jar
cookies.blurb: See, edit and clear the cookies kept for each domain.

requestSettings.title: Request settings
requestSettings.blurb: Set the timeout, redirects and TLS verification for a single request.
requestSettings.synonyms: settings timeout redirect tls verify ssl follow

hexView.title: Hex view
hexView.blurb: Read a response body as offsets, hexadecimal bytes and text.

msgpackCbor.title: MessagePack and CBOR
msgpackCbor.blurb: Decode MessagePack and CBOR responses to JSON text you can search and copy.

certificateViewer.title: Certificate chain and redirects
certificateViewer.blurb: The Timeline tab lists the certificate chain a server presented, with validity dates, names and fingerprints, and a table of redirect hops.
certificateViewer.synonyms: certificate tls ssl chain x509 https redirect hops timeline expiry

jwtSigning.title: JWT signing
jwtSigning.blurb: Sign a JWT in the Auth tab with a JWK private key and set when it expires.
jwtSigning.synonyms: jwt sign jwk token expiry bearer hs256 rs256

httpVersion.title: HTTP version
httpVersion.blurb: Choose Automatic, HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 for a request. The Timeline shows the protocol that was used.
httpVersion.synonyms: http2 http/2 http1 protocol version alpn prior knowledge

dnsOverride.title: Host overrides
dnsOverride.blurb: Send a host to a fixed address, as curl --resolve does, and limit connections to IPv4 or IPv6.
dnsOverride.synonyms: dns resolve host hosts override ip ipv4 ipv6 curl

graphqlUpload.title: GraphQL file upload
graphqlUpload.blurb: Send files in a GraphQL request with the multipart request spec from the Files tab.
graphqlUpload.synonyms: graphql upload multipart file files mutation

wsSecurity.title: SOAP WS-Security
wsSecurity.blurb: Add a WS-Security UsernameToken (plain or digest) and Timestamp to a SOAP request from the Auth tab.
wsSecurity.synonyms: soap wsse ws-security wsdl xml usernametoken digest

grpcWeb.title: gRPC-Web and Connect
grpcWeb.blurb: Call gRPC services over gRPC-Web or Connect, which also works from the web app.

signalr.title: SignalR
signalr.blurb: Negotiate with a SignalR hub, connect over WebSocket and invoke its methods.

tcpUdp.title: TCP and UDP
tcpUdp.blurb: Send text or hex over TCP or UDP and read the reply. Desktop app, trusted folders only.
tcpUdp.synonyms: tcp udp socket raw bytes hex

breakpoints.title: Held calls
breakpoints.blurb: Hold a captured request or response with a rule, edit it, then release it or drop it.
breakpoints.synonyms: breakpoint breakpoints pause hold intercept edit release drop debug

jsonRpc.title: JSON-RPC calls
jsonRpc.blurb: Add a JSON-RPC 2.0 call or a batch to a JSON body with one button.
jsonRpc.synonyms: json-rpc jsonrpc rpc batch method params id

responseCompare.title: Earlier responses
responseCompare.blurb: Each tab keeps its last 10 responses; open one or compare it with the latest.
responseCompare.synonyms: earlier previous responses compare diff history response

responseHar.title: Export responses as HAR
responseHar.blurb: Save a tab's kept responses as a HAR file with credentials masked.

splitView.title: Response beside the tab
splitView.blurb: Show another tab's latest response in a pane beside the open tab, from the request menu in the sidebar.
splitView.synonyms: split side by side beside pane response compare

globalSearch.title: Search everywhere
globalSearch.blurb: Search saved requests, history and open responses in one place.
globalSearch.synonyms: search find global everywhere requests history responses

dependencyGraph.title: Variable dependencies
dependencyGraph.blurb: See which requests set a variable and which read it.
dependencyGraph.synonyms: dependency dependencies graph variables extract set read

openTabs.title: Open tabs list
openTabs.blurb: Show the open tabs as a list in the sidebar and jump between them.

history.title: History
history.blurb: Every request you send is kept, with its response status, so you can open it again.

collections.title: Collections and folders
collections.blurb: Group requests in nested folders, drag them into place, search, tag and colour them.
collections.synonyms: collection folder tree sidebar organize tag postman collections

folderWorkspace.title: Folder workspaces
folderWorkspace.blurb: Keep a collection as plain YAML files next to your code and share it through Git.
folderWorkspace.synonyms: folder workspace yaml files git bruno opencollection
folderWorkspace.webInstead: On the web, your collections are kept in this browser. Export them to share or back them up.

folderSettings.title: Folder settings
folderSettings.blurb: Set headers, auth, variables, scripts and checks once for every request in a folder.
folderSettings.synonyms: folder collection settings inherit headers auth scripts

import.title: Import
import.blurb: Bring in Postman, Bruno, Insomnia, OpenAPI, HAR, WSDL, .http files and curl commands.
import.synonyms: import postman bruno insomnia openapi swagger har wsdl http curl migrate

specImporters.title: More import formats
specImporters.blurb: Import Hoppscotch, Thunder Client, HTTPie, Hurl, RAML and API Blueprint files. Hurl is also an export format. Paw and Firecamp files are not read.
specImporters.synonyms: hoppscotch thunder client hurl raml blueprint httpie restfox import migrate

export.title: Export
export.blurb: Write a collection to Postman, OpenAPI, Markdown, .http files or a backup.
export.synonyms: export postman openapi markdown backup http

share.title: Share links
share.blurb: Send a collection as an encrypted link or file, with no account.
share.synonyms: share link encrypted send team collaborate

versionedDocs.title: Versioned documentation
versionedDocs.blurb: gostman docs --versions builds documentation for each Git tag, and --logo and --accent style the page.
versionedDocs.synonyms: docs documentation html publish version tags logo accent

notes.title: Notes
notes.blurb: Keep a thread of notes on a request or folder, saved in its file so teammates review it in Git.

recentlyDeleted.title: Recently deleted
recentlyDeleted.blurb: Restore deleted requests, folders and environments for 30 days.
recentlyDeleted.synonyms: trash bin deleted restore undo recover

backups.title: Backups
backups.blurb: Daily and per-version backups of your data, with restore.

environments.title: Environments
environments.blurb: Switch between sets of variables for local, staging and production.
environments.synonyms: environment variables dev staging prod env

scopes.title: Variable scopes
scopes.blurb: Global, collection, folder, environment, session and request variables, with a clear order of precedence.
scopes.synonyms: variables scopes precedence global collection folder request vars

secrets.title: Secret variables
secrets.blurb: Keep secret values in your OS keychain and out of files and exports.

secretManagers.title: Secret managers
secretManagers.blurb: Read values from Vault, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, 1Password, Bitwarden or KeePassXC at send time.
secretManagers.synonyms: vault aws azure gcp 1password bitwarden keepassxc secret manager

extract.title: Extract rules
extract.blurb: Pull a value out of a response into a variable for the next request.
extract.synonyms: extract capture chain variable response jsonpath

network.title: Proxy and certificates
network.blurb: Use a proxy, client certificates and custom CA certificates.
network.synonyms: proxy certificate mtls ca tls network

checks.title: Checks
checks.blurb: Assert on status, headers, body and timing without writing code.
checks.synonyms: checks tests assertions assert postman tests chai

scripts.title: Scripts
scripts.blurb: Run JavaScript before and after a request with pm, bru and insomnia compatible APIs.
scripts.synonyms: script pre-request post-response javascript pm bru insomnia

contract.title: Contract checks
contract.blurb: Check responses against an OpenAPI spec in the runner and in CI.
contract.synonyms: contract openapi schema validate conformance dredd

snapshotChecks.title: Snapshot checks
snapshotChecks.blurb: Compare a response value with a stored snapshot, leave out paths that change and refresh it from the last response.
snapshotChecks.synonyms: snapshot golden diff regression matches ignore

negativeTests.title: Negative tests
negativeTests.blurb: Send altered copies of saved requests and flag a 2xx for bad input, a 5xx, a stack trace or a reflected payload.
negativeTests.synonyms: negative fuzz fuzzing security injection invalid inputs boundary schemathesis owasp

coverage.title: OpenAPI coverage
coverage.blurb: See which operations of a linked OpenAPI spec a run called and which documented statuses never came back.
coverage.synonyms: coverage openapi operations untested spec min-coverage

pmPackages.title: Packages and pm.vault
pmPackages.blurb: Load shared code with require or pm.require from the packages folder of a workspace, and read secrets with pm.vault.
pmPackages.synonyms: pm packages require library postman vault shared code

specLint.title: OpenAPI linter
specLint.blurb: Check a spec for missing descriptions, examples and security.

specSync.title: Spec sync
specSync.blurb: Keep a collection in step with a remote OpenAPI spec.

runner.title: Run
runner.blurb: Run a folder in order with CSV, JSON or XLSX data files, parallel runs and HTML or JUnit reports.
runner.synonyms: runner run collection postman collection runner newman data csv json xlsx iteration

flows.title: Flows
flows.blurb: Draw a sequence of requests with branches, retries and loops.
flows.synonyms: flow workflow chain retry branch loop scenario

loadTest.title: Load test
loadTest.blurb: Send many requests at once and read latency percentiles and errors.
loadTest.synonyms: load performance stress k6 benchmark latency
loadTest.webInstead: On the web, run the collection with a data file and read the timings of each request in the runner.

loadThresholds.title: Load thresholds
loadThresholds.blurb: Write thresholds such as p95<300 or errors<1% and read pass or fail in the load test.
loadThresholds.synonyms: threshold slo limit fail load stages ramp

scan.title: Scan secrets
scan.blurb: Find tokens and passwords in a collection before you share it.
scan.synonyms: scan secrets leak token password credential gitleaks

cli.title: Command line
cli.blurb: Run, send, load test, scan and lint from one binary, with exit codes for CI.
cli.synonyms: cli command line terminal newman bruno cli inso

ci.title: CI integration
ci.blurb: A GitHub Action, a Docker image, recipes for GitLab, Azure Pipelines, CircleCI, Bitbucket and Jenkins, and JUnit and HTML reports.
ci.synonyms: ci github actions gitlab azure circleci bitbucket jenkins docker pipeline junit

ciStarters.title: CI starters and pre-commit
ciStarters.blurb: gostman init --ci writes a starter pipeline for GitHub, GitLab, Azure, CircleCI or Bitbucket. Pre-commit hooks run lint, scan and run.
ciStarters.synonyms: ci pipeline starter template pre-commit hook makefile azure circleci bitbucket

monitors.title: Monitors
monitors.blurb: Run a folder or a flow on a timer while the app is open, and keep pass rates, history and notifications.
monitors.synonyms: monitor monitors postman monitor schedule cron uptime interval notify

agents.title: Coding agents
agents.blurb: An MCP server that lets coding agents send requests, with secret redaction and a host allowlist.
agents.synonyms: agent mcp claude cursor ai coding skill

mock.title: Mock server
mock.blurb: Serve saved examples or an OpenAPI spec locally, with a live request log.
mock.synonyms: mock server stub fake wiremock prism examples
mock.webInstead: On the web, save examples on your requests; they are kept with the collection and included in exports. To serve them over HTTP, run the mock server from the CLI or the desktop app.

mockRules.title: Mock rules
mockRules.blurb: Pick a response by query, header or body, add delays and inject faults.
mockRules.synonyms: mock rules conditions delay fault latency

capture.title: Capture proxy
capture.blurb: Forward traffic to an upstream, record it and turn it into requests.
capture.synonyms: capture proxy record traffic intercept charles fiddler mitm
capture.webInstead: On the web, paste a curl command or import a HAR file to build requests from traffic you recorded elsewhere.

captureRules.title: Capture rules
captureRules.blurb: Edit headers and bodies, answer locally, inject failures or throttle the calls that match a rule.
captureRules.synonyms: capture rules rewrite block map local throttle slow latency fault

captureHar.title: Capture to HAR
captureHar.blurb: Export captured calls as a HAR 1.2 file that other tools read.

gitPanel.title: Git panel
gitPanel.blurb: Diff, commit, push, branches, stash and history in the app.
gitPanel.synonyms: git commit push pull branch stash diff version control
gitPanel.webInstead: On the web, use Share or Export to move a collection. For version control, keep a folder workspace in the desktop app or the CLI.

gitFieldDiff.title: Field-level diffs
gitFieldDiff.blurb: See which fields of a request changed, such as URL, headers, auth, body and checks, and compare two versions of a file.
gitFieldDiff.synonyms: git diff field changes yaml review compare versions

gitCommitGraph.title: Commit graph
gitCommitGraph.blurb: Read the history with a lane graph of branches, merges and tags.
gitCommitGraph.synonyms: git graph commits branches log history tags merge

conflicts.title: Conflict resolution
conflicts.blurb: Resolve merge conflicts in a request file with a side by side editor.

repoCreate.title: Create a GitHub repository
repoCreate.blurb: Create a GitHub repository from the Remotes tab and push to it.
repoCreate.synonyms: git init repository github publish remote create push

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.blurb: Generate requests, checks and scripts and explain responses, with your own key.
ai.synonyms: ai llm openai anthropic claude generate explain postbot

aiMock.title: AI mock examples
aiMock.blurb: Generate a mock response example for a request with AI, shown as a preview you accept.
aiMock.synonyms: ai mock generate data fake example response

aiCommit.title: AI commit messages
aiCommit.blurb: Draft a commit message from the staged changes with Suggest message with AI in the Git panel.
aiCommit.synonyms: ai commit message git draft suggest

palette.title: Command palette
palette.blurb: Find any command, request or feature by name.
palette.synonyms: palette command search quick open ctrl k

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.blurb: See every shortcut and change the ones you want.
shortcuts.synonyms: keyboard shortcuts keys hotkeys chords bindings

themes.title: Themes and colours
themes.blurb: Light, dark and custom colours for each part of the window.
themes.synonyms: theme dark light color colour appearance accent font

languages.title: Languages
languages.blurb: Use the app in another language, including right-to-left layouts.
languages.synonyms: language translation locale i18n localization arabic

desktop.title: Desktop app
desktop.blurb: Folders, Git, the mock server, capture, proxies and certificates need the desktop app.
desktop.synonyms: desktop download install app windows mac linux

webApp.title: Web app
webApp.blurb: Use Gostman in the browser with no account and nothing to install.
webApp.synonyms: web browser online no install pwa

vscode.title: VS Code extension
vscode.blurb: There is no VS Code extension.

xlsxData.title: Data files
xlsxData.blurb: Run a folder once for each row of a CSV, JSON or XLSX file, in the app or with gostman run --data.
xlsxData.synonyms: data csv json xlsx excel spreadsheet iteration rows data-driven

scheduledRuns.title: Scheduled runs
scheduledRuns.blurb: gostman run --every repeats a run on an interval, keeps a local history and can notify a webhook.
scheduledRuns.synonyms: schedule cron every interval repeat history webhook notify

openapiDiff.title: OpenAPI diff
openapiDiff.blurb: Compare two versions of an OpenAPI spec and list breaking changes in the app, or with gostman diff in CI.
openapiDiff.synonyms: openapi diff oasdiff breaking changes compare spec

featureSamples.flowDescription: Lists the users, then reads one of them. Both requests come from the sample collection.
